description: Render a finished image: give it a template id from search_templates and the photo URLs to place, and it returns the rendered design. Photos are placed into the template's image slots in the order given, so pass them in the order you want them to appear. Photos attached in the conversation go in `photos`; photos already on the web go in `images`. Each render spends one agentic token.

coverId.description: Template id, from a search_templates result.

images.description: Publicly reachable image URLs, in placement order.

photos.description: Photos the person attached in this conversation, in placement order. Use this OR images, not both.

name: fill_template
title: Render a template with your photos
